native_profile: Fresh combined broker/controller per SDK release and Rust feature build; genuine Java and Rust raw API55v0/v1/v2 plus public Admin highest shared version; captured public request/response frames independently decoded.
local_policy_differences: 1MiB complete body; 32767 bytes each string (SDK serialization ceiling)/1MiB total; 8192 elements each array/32768 total; 4MiB requested vector slots and string copies; 64 tags per structure/1024 total; 64KiB total tag payload; ordered unique unknown tags skipped. Limits are explicit local admission policy; no RSS or allocator capacity guarantee.
Rust public retry cap8 returns last error when exhausted; Java retries until its operation deadline. Both have finite original operation budgets.
Rust absent v0/v1 error messages use None, Java generated DTO defaults empty string. Neither field is transmitted.
Rust decoder refuses trailing bytes/invalid UTF8 and skips opaque tags. Java retains opaque tags; reverse comparison clears only those tags.
supersedes: applicability-01 through04 retained. Final declaration adds exact ValueSource/CsvSource invocations from each pinned source, without assuming a boolean Cartesian product. It retains the recorded warm-up policy and precedes the complete fresh SDK qualification.
public_deadline_preparation: One genuine public success operation on the same Admin instance before the measured deadline or retry-exhaustion operation; other profiles use cold instances. All warm-up frames are retained and independently decoded.
